stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: Material left at each outlet and what it is worth. It goes down by itself with orders; the buttons on the right are only for recording anything else.
stock.pickOutlet: Pick one outlet to see every material, including those with no stock yet.

form.invalidQty: The quantity must be a decimal with at most 4 decimal places.
form.same: The count equals the book stock: nothing changes.
form.invalidCost: Enter the total cost in whole rupiah

stock.howItWorks: Stock goes down by itself when an order is processed. Only record here what happens outside orders: goods in, goods thrown away, or a difference found when counting.

hint.receipt: Use this when you buy or receive material. Stock goes up by the quantity you enter. Example: you bought 5 litres of detergent for Rp 85,000: enter 5000 and a total of 85000.
hint.waste: Use this when material is damaged, spilled, lost or expired and so is not used. Stock goes down by the quantity you enter. Example: 50 ml of perfume was spilled.
hint.adjustment: Use this after you count the material on the shelf. Enter what is really there; the system adjusts the stock and records the difference.
hint.transfer: Moves part of the stock to another outlet. Stock here goes down, at the destination it goes up.
hint.min: When the stock drops to this figure or lower, the material is marked Low.

flow.3: Discard or Count when something differs

stock.emptyTitle: Nothing to keep in stock yet
stock.emptyDescription: Stock is kept per material. Add a material first, then record its first goods in here.

history.title: Stock history
history.subtitle: Everything that happened to stock, newest first. A record cannot be edited; if something is wrong, make a new one.
history.search: Search note, document no. or supplier...
history.emptyDescription: Every goods-in, discard and use by an order is recorded here.
